name: workout
description: A mobile-first workout tracker for planning routines, logging sets, and tracking strength progress.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.check: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke:health && git diff --check
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
